answer_text:
Here's a comprehensive guide to getting **free satellite radio** in 2026:

---

## 🛰️ Free Satellite Radio Options

### 1. **SiriusXM Free 3-Month Trial (In-Car)**
SiriusXM offers a free 3-month trial subscription that includes every channel, including every premium channel, plus access inside and outside the car and on the app.

- The car satellite radio option will ask for a VIN, but that's it.
- This offer is available only on qualifying inactive radios as determined solely by SiriusXM.

---

### 2. **SiriusXM Free 3-Month Streaming Trial (App)**
SiriusXM also offers 3 months free of SiriusXM Streaming, a $29.97 value.

- This offer gives you the same radio accessible on your phone, tablet, and computer.
- The streaming option will ask for a credit card, but it won't charge you until the 3 months is over.

---

### 3. **New Car Trial**
If you just drove off the lot in a shiny new car, chances are that SiriusXM Satellite Radio is a standard feature on your radio and free of charge for a certain period of time.

- Every manufacturer currently offers a radio with SiriusXM built into its capabilities.

---

### 4. **What's Included in the Free Trial?**
Both free offers give you hundreds of channels of ad-free music curated by genre, era, and even artist-inspired channels. You'll also have access to live sports – including MLB, NFL, NBA, NHL, NASCAR, & college sports – plus original talk shows, news coverage, interviews, podcasts, and much more.

---

### 5. **Periodic Free Listening Events**
SiriusXM also occasionally runs free listening periods for everyone. For example, SiriusXM was free from May 21 – June 1, allowing anyone to listen to great music, sports analysis, comedy and more. Keep an eye on their website for future free listening events.

---

### 6. **Free Alternatives to Satellite Radio**
If you're looking for permanently free options, consider these streaming alternatives:
- Streaming services like **Pandora**, **Spotify**, and **Apple Music** have taken ownership of the music industry and are go-to options for music listeners.
- Services like **Apple Podcasts** and **Stitcher** stream specific talk listening right to your phone, offering variety that SiriusXM just can't match.

---

### 💡 Tips for Getting SiriusXM Cheaply After the Trial
- You can activate a new radio/tuner with the All Access plan and pay $4.98 each month for your first 12 months.
- For road trips, SiriusXM is a great value — you can start in California and end up in Massachusetts and listen to the same channel coast to coast with barely an interruption, because it's satellite based and the whole country is covered.

**Visit [siriusxm.com/free-trial](https://www.siriusxm.com/free-trial) to start your free trial today!**
